keywords.title: Keywords (any)
keywords.description: Full-text search over the notice (any language). Several keywords are combined with OR.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes (8 digits, check digit optional). Matching is hierarchical: 72000000 also finds 72200000, 72212000 … e.g. 72000000 IT services, 45000000 construction, 33000000 medical equipment.

countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: ISO 3166 alpha-3 codes of the buyer's country, e.g. DEU, FRA, ITA, ESP, POL, NLD.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types

enumTitles: PIN used as call for competition

noticeTypes.description: Limit to these notice types. Contract notices (cn-…) are open calls for tenders. Leave empty for all.

publishedFrom.title: Published from
publishedFrom.description: Earliest publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). If no date and no custom query is given, the last 'Days back' days are searched.

daysBack.title: Days back (default window)
daysBack.description: Used only when neither publication date nor a custom query is set.

onlyOpen.title: Only notices with an open deadline
onlyOpen.description: Drop notices whose tender submission deadlines (date and time, all lots) have passed. Notices without a deadline are dropped too.

language.title: Preferred language
language.description: 3-letter code for titles, buyer names and links (eng, deu, fra, ita, spa, pol …). Falls back to English, then any available language.

customQuery.title: Custom TED expert query (advanced)
customQuery.description: Optional extra condition in TED expert search syntax, combined with the filters above by AND, e.g. buyer-city = Wien.

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode: only new notices
onlyNew.description: Remember notices already returned and output only new ones. Schedule daily with a short window (e.g. daysBack 3).

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Separate 'already seen' list per search. Letters, digits, - and _ only. Do not run two schedules with the same key at the same time.

maxItems.title: Max notices
maxItems.description: Maximum number of notices to output.

requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between API pages (ms)
requestIntervalMs.description: Pause between search requests (100 notices per page).
